description: Per-ceremony performance record. G11 STRUCTURAL: chigiriCovenantAttestationCid REQUIRED for marriage/naming/funeral/vocation-vow/rededication (NOT seasonal_communal). G7 STRUCTURAL: bridePriceOrDowryAttested const false (anti-coercive ceremony economy). G8 STRUCTURAL: videoRecordingPerPartyConsent REQUIRED if video produced. G10 multi-gen cohortRatio enforced via $ref.

primaryPartyDids.description: DID(s) of primary ceremony participants (1 for naming/funeral; ≥2 for marriage; varies otherwise)

partyConsentCids.description: G5 REQUIRED: per-party consent record CIDs (chigiri.consentRecord)

officiantAttestationCid.description: Cross-link to musubi.officiantAttestation CID; G3 + G12 structural enforcement happens at officiantAttestation level

ceremonyVenueLandRegistryCid.description: Land Registry CID for ceremony location (typically donated land per ADR-2605192245 waqf-equivalent)

chigiriCovenantAttestationCid.description: G11 REQUIRED for ceremonyType ∈ {marriage, naming, funeral, vocation-vow, rededication, covenant-restoration}; not applicable for seasonal-communal

chigiriInheritanceChainCid.description: When ceremonyType=funeral, cross-link to chigiri.inheritanceChain CID

stewardLaborAttestationCid.description: When ceremonyType=vocation-vow, cross-link to chigiri.stewardLaborAttestation (L5 vocation-flow)

bridePriceOrDowryAttested.description: G7 STRUCTURAL: const false; bride price / dowry coercive economic structure PROHIBITED

giftsExchangedAttested.description: True if non-coercive gifts exchanged (お祝い金 / お見舞い / 香典); not equivalent to bride price

videoRecordingPerPartyConsent.description: G8 REQUIRED if videoRecordingProduced=true: per-party consent attestation CIDs

cohortRatio.description: G10 STRUCTURAL: multi-gen ratio per ceremony

publicFundVenueGrantCid.description: Optional Public Fund grant CID for venue/supplies (toritate cross-actor)
